columns: Note:  Data is organized by number of restrictors used.  Not all restrictors were comonly used, so often the fan calibration only includes the restrictors of interest for that day. Some days we ran out of time before the fan cal could be complete.   There are additional flow values that were used during testing when the fan is on at a fixed voltage for at least a few minutes.   Note that the fan turns off at a finite voltage (above 3.8 volts), so it is recommended to not use the 3.8 volts zero flow value.
Fan Calibration data: Based on SPICE fan calibration data at 56 mm downstream, 36 mm from bottom (centerline)
